//: What: npm manifest of the sample tenant extension project: which SaaS app it extends (extends), the .base workspace that `cds pull` fills with the app's base model, and the CAP dependency used by `cds push`.
Why: [CAP-M21] / [CAP-STAGE-09] customers extend a subscribed SaaS app in their own project and push the result to their tenant only; this is the template a provider hands out.
If missing or unlinked: cds pull and cds push do not know which app to extend, and `using from 'procurement-stage-10'` cannot be resolved.
name: procurement-ext-sample
description: Sample tenant extension for ACME Procurement (stage 09): adds a delivery note to purchase orders.
